Name: New Sprites for Mister Ginger
Author: lapeocon
Description:
I love [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657]lemurkat[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5295]Mister Ginger NPC[/url]. I also love [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/50506661]ciafey[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9380]Orange Cat[/url] that recolours the orange cat sprites. So, I took lemur and ciafey's respective cats and shoved 'em together! Now Mr. Ginger can look just like the other cats in my (and maybe your) game. 

[b]To use:
[/b][list]
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5295]Mister Ginger (Cat NPC)[/url]﻿﻿
[*]Download my mod and use these images to replace "MisterGinger_Fish" and "MisterGingerSprites" in your "[CP] MrGinger\assets\Images" folder.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Converted by ssoldavini. Use this spritesheet if you also use lemurkat's Tristan.
